text:
[somber] Before the fall... we called ourselves Guardians.

[reflective] We carried the Light — the last ember of a dying sun — and we swore... that no darkness would take the worlds of humankind.

For a hundred years, we held the line. [resigned] We believed we always would.

[ominous] The Ember Collective did not come with fleets. They came with doors... torn into the sky... spilling fire from somewhere older than the stars.

[grave] Earth was the first to burn. Its cities fell from the inside out... its oceans went to ash.

Then Mars. [whispering] Then the long silence between the worlds.

[sorrowful] One by one... the Guardians fell. And the Light went out of the world.

[quiet] The Vanguard drifted a hundred years... a dead ship on a dark tide... its last pilot asleep in the cold.

[hopeful] But a single light was never meant to go out. It only waited.

[building] Now something stirs beneath the ash of Earth. An Archive... a memory of how the doors were opened...

[resolute] and how they can be closed. Forever.

[awe] The ship is waking. The Light remembers your name.

[commanding] Rise... Guardian.
